title: Cap Chaos level — format v4
description: One level's ITEMS, fully data-driven (GDD §6): the bottles each feeder carries, the lanes and their trays. The top conveyor's LAYOUT (rows, width, pick zone, shape, merge points) is a shared file the level names by id (`conveyor`, see conveyor.schema.json) — many levels reuse one. Written for designers and their own tools: every colour is a NUMBER (see $defs.colorId), every flag is a named field. Structural checks live here; semantic checks (colour balance, solvability, link targets, merge points and pick zone, shape) are LevelValidator V4–V9. Format v3 kept the conveyor inline and v1/v2 describe a bottle stack: none of them load.

id.description: Must equal the file name without extension.

conveyor.description: The shared top-conveyor layout this level runs on: Conveyors/<conveyor>.json next to the level files.

extraSlots.description: Locked slots right of the open ones (R20): each opens for coins or a rewarded ad, for this round only. slots + extraSlots ≤ 6.

colors.description: Palette subset used by this level. Hex values live in DesignTokens, never here.

feeders.description: One queue per feeder of the named conveyor, in its feeder order (R4) — required when the conveyor has feeders. A queue joins the belt a whole row at a time at that feeder's mergeAt.

bottles.description: The queue, front first, row by row: bottle i waits in queue row i / width on track i % width. The generator paints every queue row one colour.

initial.description: Optional: the belt at the start, one array of the conveyor's `width` cellIds per row, as many rows as the conveyor has (row r starts at track position r). Absent = the belt starts empty; every bottle waits in a feeder and joins while the belt runs.

lanes.description: Conveyor queues left→right. Element [0] of each lane is the tappable front tray.

links.description: Linked tray pairs (R19): they fly to the slots together (2 free slots needed); belts carrying a pair across two lanes only move together. V7: two neighbours in one lane, or the same position of two neighbouring lanes; a tray is in at most one link and is never locked.

solution.description: One winning tap sequence (lane indices). Written by Tools/LevelTool; V6 replays it as the solvability proof.

colorId.description: Game.Domain.CapColor: 1 Red (pink-red) · 2 Orange · 3 Blue · 4 Green · 5 Purple · 6 Yellow · 7 Cyan · 8 Brown. Never renumbered.

cellId.description: 0 = empty belt spot, otherwise a colorId.

hidden.description: Hidden tray (R17): tray and caps show '?' until the tray reaches the front of its lane.

size.description: Container size (R21): 1 S · 2 M · 3 L · 4 XL. Takes size × trayCapacity items (trayCapacity 4: 4 / 8 / 12 / 16).

lockTurns.description: Locked tray (R18): opens after this many trays fly to the slots while it stands at the front.
